title: EntraAccountPhoto — Microsoft Graph Credentials
description: Credentials for Entra-Account-Photo.sh (CRED_SOURCE=profile/auto). Preference Domain 'com.company.entraphoto' must equal CONFIG_PROFILE_DOMAIN in the script. Provide Client ID + Tenant ID, then EXACTLY ONE of Certificate PEM (preferred) or Client Secret. Deliver at Computer level so it lands at /Library/Managed Preferences/<domain>.plist.

ClientID.title: Client ID
ClientID.description: Entra app registration Application (client) ID (GUID). Required.

TenantID.title: Tenant ID
TenantID.description: Entra Directory (tenant) ID (GUID) or a verified domain. Required.

CertificatePEM.title: Certificate PEM (preferred auth)
CertificatePEM.description: PREFERRED. Full combined PEM containing BOTH the certificate block AND its private-key block (PKCS#8), with all BEGIN/END lines kept. The script signs a PS256 client assertion with it; upload only the matching PUBLIC certificate to the Entra app registration. Leave blank if using Client Secret instead.

ClientSecret.title: Client Secret (fallback auth)
ClientSecret.description: FALLBACK. Entra app client secret VALUE, used only when Certificate PEM is blank. Anyone who can read this profile in Jamf can read it — prefer certificate auth. Leave blank if using Certificate PEM.
